    LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.exists_preprojComp

    The separation theorem #

    Theorem (Bongartz, A criterion for finite representation type, 2.5). A directed algebra with vertex idempotents, at least one live point, and a separating decomposition of every radical rad P(z) has a preprojective component (exists_preprojComp).

    Proof: if every radical summand Rⱼ(y) is good, the good modules form a preprojective component (preprojComp_of_good_R). Otherwise take Rⱼ(y) not good and B = Bⱼ(y), which has fewer points and inherits separating decompositions (sepDecomp_descend); by induction its quotient algebra has a preprojective component C. If some member of C restricted Rⱼ(y), then Rⱼ(y) would be good (good_res); so none does, and C restricts to a preprojective component of A (preprojComp_transport).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.exists_preprojComp {k : Type u} [Field k] (N : ℕ) {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (D : DirData k A) (sd : (z : D.ι) → Decomp (D.RadP z)) :
    (∀ z ∈ D.T, D.SepDecomp z (sd z)) → D.T.ncard ≤ N → D.T.Nonempty → ∃ (𝒞 : FDMod k A → Prop), PreprojComp 𝒞
